body.heading: Where in the world is Bahrain?
paragraphs: Bahrain is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Bahrain is Manama.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Bahrain is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Bahrain is the Bahraini dinar.

body.heading: How big is Bahrain?
paragraphs: Bahrain covers about 765 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: This seaside fort hill has been built up by civilisations for 4,500 years — Portuguese walls on top of the ancient Dilmun capital, right beside the sea.
In the middle of the desert stands one huge mesquite tree that has lived for around 400 years with no visible water source — a famous natural mystery.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Bahrain on a map or globe. Which continent is it nearest to — and what sea or ocean surrounds it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
